_about: Codes not found in the FIADB v9.4 User Guide transcription (fia_codes.json), with the published sources checked. status 'decoded' is used only when a source explicitly defines the code; otherwise 'undecoded'.

81.label: undecoded: State-specific periodic code; no FIA source checked defines 81
81.range_context: Every FIADB guide checked (v1.7 2004 to v9.4 2025) says 'Each FIA program records specific codes that may differ from one State to the next. These codes fall within the ranges listed below' and lists only 80 (v1.7: 'Human-caused (cultural, logging, accidental, etc.)'; v3.0-v9.4: 'Silvicultural or landclearing activity'). The Eastwide database manual (NC-151, 1992) lists the range '80-89 Logging'. These give the range, not a definition of 81.
81.evidence: SC_TREE statewide: 32,719 of 32,721 AGENTCD 81 records are STATUSCD 3 (cut), 2 are STATUSCD 2; the code occurs only in periodic inventories INVYR 1968, 1978, 1986, 1993 (codes 82-85 occur alongside).
